name: Andrew Bellinson
tagline: Top rated Elder Law attorney in Miami, Florida
side_practice_areas: Elder Law, Administrative Law, Estate Planning & Probate
about: Attorney Andrew Bellinson is the owner and managing partner of Bellinson Law Firm in Miami, Florida. A top-rated lawyer with more than 27 years of legal experience, Mr. Bellinson provides invaluable counsel and support to clients throughout South Florida who have legal needs involving any of the following:

With a wide and varied background in finance, elder law and other areas, Mr. Bellinson is able to better address his clients' needs and help them achieve their goals and the favorable outcomes they seek for their end-of-life matters as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible. Throughout the course of his legal career, he has assisted thousands of clients with protecting themselves, their assets and their loved ones for the future, and he has gained a reputation for his in-depth legal knowledge and the personalized attention he provides.

Honored for his outstanding professionalism and service, Mr. Bellinson has earned consistent top rankings and endorsements from his peers, and he has received designation as among the top 5% of attorneys in his area for estate planning, elder law and VA-related matters. He has also received numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients.

A graduate of the University of Arizona with a degree in international relations and psychology, Mr. Bellinson attended Tulane University School of Law, where he was the president of his class and served as editor to one of the school's law reviews. He also studied abroad for a time at the Shanghai Institute of Law, where he focused mainly on Chinese trade law.

Mr. Bellinson obtained his Juris Doctor in 1993, and The Florida Bar admitted him to practice that same year. He is also admitted to practice before the Federal Bar of the United States as well as before the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Florida. Outside his legal practice, he serves on the board of the Urban League of Miami, and he is the director of the Liberty City Charter School.
